question:
**Direction: Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence and select its correct spelling from the given options.**

The preview version will give you a glimpse of the entaire book.
solution:
The correct answer is **"entire."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word which is spelt incorrectly is **"entaire."**
 
• The word **"entire"** means whole or complete. (पूरा, समूचा, संपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example**: *They liked the **entire**__ room.*
 
 
 
• It is spelled with an **"e"** after the **"t"** and before the **"i".**
 
• The other options are spelled incorrectly and do not match the correct spelling of the word in the sentence.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
